scope: Structured DROID SequenceExample lineage audit v4
summary: Structured raw paths, tasks, frame counts, all wrist streams, and all episode-60 streams matched, but nominal exterior stream names failed for episodes 21 and 77.
evidence: All three wrist streams passed with frame-level PSNR p05 of 34.704-35.900 dB.
Episode 60 exterior streams passed nominal identity mapping at 33.860-34.063 dB PSNR p05.
Episodes 21 and 77 nominal exterior mappings scored only 8.630-9.302 dB and failed.
A complete two-by-two diagnostic showed that swapping exterior_image_1_left and exterior_image_2_left raises those four p05 values to 33.201-36.297 dB.
lessons: DROID exterior camera numbering is episode-local in this TFDS-to-LeRobot lineage and cannot be assumed globally identical.
limitations: The v4 audit did not predeclare or record an exterior assignment policy, so its overall pixel gate remained false.
next_actions: Predeclare the only two one-to-one exterior assignments, select by summed median PSNR, keep the original PSNR/dHash thresholds, and rerun.
